repos.name: openBitFun/OpenBitFun
repos.description: OpenBitFun combines a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust with a polished desktop application. It pairs the depth of a Code Agent with open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance agent runtime built in Rust designed to power sophisticated, general-purpose code agents.
bullets: Built with a Rust-based runtime for high-concurrency and memory-safe agent execution.
Integrates a polished desktop UI with deep code-agent capabilities for complex workflows.
Designed for developers needing an extensible framework for autonomous software engineering tasks.
Focuses on bridging the gap between raw LLM reasoning and practical desktop automation.
repos.img_alt: Four working modes: Minimal, Standard, Ultimate, and Creative
repos.img2_alt: Switching between connected computers and remotely controlling the selected device from a phone

repos.name: DeadInternetStudios/100x-engineer-skill
repos.description: 100x is a skill by a former Cursor engineer that turns prompts into formally verified, production-ready code
repos.one_liner: A specialized tool for transforming natural language prompts into formally verified, production-ready code.
bullets: Leverages advanced prompt engineering techniques developed by former Cursor engineers.
Focuses on formal verification to ensure code reliability and security in production environments.
Automates the transition from high-level intent to executable, high-quality software artifacts.
Ideal for quant developers or fintech engineers requiring high-assurance code generation.

repos.name: pithings/unkernel
repos.description: A real Linux kernel, compiled to WebAssembly. It boots to a shell in less than a second.
repos.one_liner: A full Linux kernel compiled to WebAssembly that boots to a shell in under one second.
bullets: Utilizes WebAssembly (Wasm) to achieve near-instantaneous kernel boot times in browser environments.
Provides a sandboxed, portable infrastructure layer for running Linux-based tools anywhere.
Enables lightweight, ephemeral compute environments for edge-based data processing.
Significant for infra-focused developers building secure, browser-based execution platforms.

repos.name: m-bain/whisperX
repos.description: WhisperX:  Automatic Speech Recognition with Word-level Timestamps (& Diarization)
repos.one_liner: An advanced automatic speech recognition system providing word-level timestamps and speaker diarization.
bullets: Built on top of OpenAI's Whisper model with optimized alignment for precise word-level timing.
Includes robust speaker diarization to identify and separate multiple voices in audio streams.
Essential for financial compliance, meeting transcription, and automated trading signal extraction from audio.
High-performance Python stack optimized for accurate, large-scale audio processing tasks.

repos.name: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
repos.description: Leaked system prompts of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more. The hidden system prompt of every popular chatbot, in full, every version since May 2025. Also Anthropic Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, xAI Grok, Meta Muse, Moonshot Kimi, Alibaba Qwen, Z.ai GLM ZCode, MiniMax, Cursor, Perplexity, DeepSeek and 30+ others. Updated daily.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive, version-controlled repository of system prompts for major LLMs including ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
bullets: Maintains a historical archive of hidden system instructions for leading AI models since May 2025.
Provides critical insights into the safety guardrails and behavioral constraints of proprietary AI agents.
Serves as a vital resource for security researchers and AI engineers auditing model alignment.
Enables comparative analysis of how different providers structure their agentic reasoning frameworks.
